segments.name: Pop culture consumer products
segments.description: Designs, licenses and sells pop culture consumer products, including figures, bags and apparel, to retailers and directly to fans.
segments.evidence: The segment derives revenue from customers by providing a wide variety of branded categories, including Core Collectible (predominately figures), Loungefly (predominately softlines including bags, wallets, backpacks and accessories) and Other (predominately Mondo and other emerging brands).

revenueModel.text: Retail customers and fans pay for licensed pop culture products such as figures, bags and apparel, bought through specialty, mass-market and e-commerce channels or directly.
revenueModel.evidence: We sell our products through a diverse network of retail customers across multiple retail channels, including specialty retailers, mass-market retailers, and e-commerce sites, as well as directly to consumers primarily through our owned websites and three flagship retail stores.
